name: Invariant prevents deletion of active site with transactions
title: SC-03-06-02 Invariant prevents deletion of active site with transactions
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given a site has active units or dues records
When SaaS Admin attempts to delete the site
Then the deletion request is blocked
And an explanatory invariant violation error is returned
